chapter: Reel 2: Crescendo Club and Good Hearts
title: Founding the Crescendo Club and who is still alive
summary: Johnson was the moving force behind the Crescendo Club, a jumping-off place for songwriters; only a few of 42 members remain, and word of mouth built it.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Right, the nitty gritty. We have a lot to talk about today, and we'll see how it goes. I was thinking that a nice place to begin today would be to talk about the Crescendo Club, and since you were the moving force behind it, I've come to the right person.
Well, I'm glad you came to me. There were about 42 members in that club, and I don't think there are over four around today.
Well, let's see, there's you and there's Eubie Blake. Who were the other couple around?
Uh huh. How did you start? What was the reason behind your starting this Crescendo Club? It was more than just a club.
Oh sure, it was a real jumping off place for a person who wanted to write, and those who have already written songs, and were eager for a little activity.
So we organized this group to kind of perpetuate the songs that had already been written.
How did you get together? How did you get that first -- the first big ...
What do they say about something being faster than a telegraph -- word of mouth?
That's how we did it. Just pass on the word that we had a meeting next Sunday, and pass the word as to where we were going to have it. And like that, we got together.
